title: This is a nice coffee grinder
text: This is a nice coffee grinder. This is a nice coffee grinder.  It isn't very quiet, but it's not bad.  It grinds the coffee well with settings for different amounts of beans and also has different degrees of grinding.  It grinds course, medium or fine.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Electric Coffee Grinder for Beans, Spices and More, with Multiple Grind Settings for up to 14 Cups, Removable Stainless Steel Chamber, Grey (80396C)
features: Your Perfect Grinder Every Time: Multiple grind settings let you customize your coffee precisely
Hands-free Grinding: Just press the button once; when grinding is complete, the grinder shuts off automatically
Removable Grinding Chamber: The stainless steel grinding chamber removes for easy filling of whole beans or spices Once finished, remove the chamber for mess-free pouring and easy cleaning
Make Up to 14 Cups of Coffee: You can grind up to 10 tablespoons of beans, enough for 14 cups of coffee
Stainless Steel Blades: Durable stainless steel blades grind coffee beans and spices with ease
Convenient hidden cord storage - just snap open, wind the cord inside & close
description: There's nothing like the aroma of a hot cup of Coffee or delicious espresso drink made from the freshest Coffee beans. Grind your own Coffee beans and experience a flavor revolution at home. There's a reason Coffee shops grind the beans right before preparing your beverage; It just tastes better. Whole Coffee beans have volatile compounds that are released when ground, and the longer ground Coffee is exposed to the air, The more it loses those compounds and aromas. Grinding the beans right before brewing will keep your coffee's rich, full-bodied flavor intact. The Hamilton Beach Coffee grinder offers hands-free operation. Add the beans and press the button for true one-touch grinding. Depending on your preference, set the grind fineness to coarse, medium, or fine. Serving a crowd? Grind enough beans to make up to 14 Cups of Coffee at once.
